build_read_csv: build a function to read a CSV file into a pandas DataFrame with custom separator and encoding
build_read_table: build a function to read a tab-delimited file into a pandas DataFrame with custom header and index columns
build_read_fwf: build a function to read a fixed-width formatted file into a pandas DataFrame using colspecs or widths

refactor_TextParser: refactor the TextParser function to wrap TextFileReader with the Python engine for list-of-lists conversion
